g.aria-label: The Hidden Cloud Bill: Outbound Data Egress vs. GPU Compute
Exceeds the cost of running an RTX 4090
Three Rules to Eliminate Egress Taxes
1. Keep compute VMs and object storage
in the EXACT SAME provider & region
Set a billing alert on Day 1 and cap account GPU quotas to bound leaked-key risk.
When an experiment finishes, tear down the VM, scratch disks, snapshots, and stale buckets.
